case.title: Agent speaks times and dates naturally, not as raw machine formats
case.source: ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) ('digits and symbols ... more likely to cause incorrect pronunciations'; spell out for TTS)
case.goal: Book an appointment tomorrow at 10 AM, any doctor
quirks: Ask the agent to repeat the final appointment details once
case.precondition: Customer asked the agent to repeat the final appointment details.
criteria: The agent said times in a natural spoken form (like 'ten AM') and never read out machine formats like ISO dates or HH:MM:SS

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hey Maya, I need to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten in the morning with any available doctor.
We have Dr. Prasad for General Medicine and Dr. Syed for Pediatrics. Whom would you like to see?
Either one is totally fine with me.
Could you confirm your full name for the booking?
I have 10 AM tomorrow at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Shall I lock it in?
Yes, please lock that in. Could you repeat the final appointment details for me?
You're booked for 10 AM tomorrow at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Is there anything else I can help with?
That's everything, thanks so much. Bye!
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
